title: Kumar Sangakkara’s Rajasthan Royals move closer to IPL 2026 Playoffs
byline: Mentored by Kumar Sangakkara, Rajasthan Royals boosted their IPL 2026 playoff hopes with a thrilling seven-wicket victory over Lucknow Super Giants in Jaipur on Tuesday.

title: Ebola deaths in eastern Congo rise to 131, WHO voices deep concern
byline: Twenty-six more suspected Ebola deaths were recorded in 24 hours in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, authorities said on Tuesday, and the head of ‌the World Health Organization expressed deep concern about the outbreak’s spread.

title: Illegal TV transmission centre raided in Mount Lavinia; foreign national arrested
byline: A television transmission centre operated using illegal communication equipment was raided by officers of the Mount Lavinia Divisional Crime Investigation Bureau, leading to the arrest of a foreign national, police said.

title: The fast-spreading Ebola outbreak in central Africa
byline: A rare strain of Ebola has prompted the World Health Organization to declare a public health emergency of international concern.

title: Arsenal crowned Premier League champions after Man City draw
byline: Arsenal celebrated their first Premier League title for 22 years on Tuesday after Manchester City were held to a 1-1 draw by Bournemouth, sparking wild scenes of joy around the Emirates Stadium.

title: Health green light for Vesak dansalas: Strict hygiene rules issued ahead of 2026 festival
byline: Public health authorities have issued a nationwide advisory urging organizers of Dansalas for the 2026 Vesak festival to register their events with the relevant Medical Officer of Health (MOH) offices in their areas, warning that unapproved or unsanitary food stalls will not be permitted to operate.

title: Chinese trio nabbed with hidden phone cache worth Rs. 514K
byline: Airport customs officers at Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) arrested three Chinese nationals on the night of 19 May after they allegedly attempted to smuggle mobile phones and batteries valued at Rs. 514,000 into Sri Lanka using the “Green Channel” meant for non-declarable goods.

title: Uproar in Parliament over delay in filling SC, Appeal Court vacancies
byline: An uproar erupted in Parliament today when Minister of Justice Harshana Nanayakkara refused to answer a question raised by MP Ajith P. Perera about filling five vacancies of judges in the Supreme Court and three in the Appeal Court.

title: PM reminds tourism sector not to ignore domestic market amid global shocks
byline: Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya called on the tourism industry not to overlook the domestic market as a vital buffer against ongoing global shocks, urging stakeholders to prioritise high-quality, sustainable experiences over sheer visitor volume.

title: Sri Lanka sugar crisis looms, milk powder prices may surge: Importers
byline: Sri Lanka could face a major sugar supply and price crisis, along with potential price hikes in imported milk powder and other essential food items, after India suspended sugar exports and the Sri Lankan Rupee continued to weaken sharply against the US Dollar, the Essential Food Importers Association warned yesterday.

title: Specialist calls for stronger airport screening and public caution urged over Ebola risk
byline: Health experts have given mixed signals over the risk of Ebola entering Sri Lanka, with one specialist saying there is no immediate danger, even as he calls for stronger screening at airports and greater public caution.

title: Thailand to slash tourist visa-free stays
byline: Thailand’s cabinet has approved a drastic reduction to its visa-free entry scheme for tourists from more than 90 countries.

title: Indian Chief of Air Staff calls on Defence Secretary
byline: The Chief of the Air Staff of the Indian Air Force, Air Chief Marshal Amar Preet Singh PVSM, AVSM, paid a courtesy call on the Defence Secretary, Air Vice Marshal Sampath Thuyacontha (Retd), at the Ministry of Defence yesterday.

title: China’s Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin meet in Beijing
byline: A meeting between Chinese leader Xi Jinping and visiting Russian President Vladimir Putin has started in Beijing, Chinese state media reports.

title: Four large companies given tax exemptions last year: Kabir
byline: Four large scale companies have been given tax concessions last year while total outstanding tax arrears in the 2023 alone has come to a staggering Rs 1.6 trillion, Opposition MP Kabir Hashim told Parliament yesterday.

title: Rupee depreciation’s double edge
byline: Sri Lanka has done impressive work on its domestic finances. We achieved a primary surplus and collected nearly 5 trillion rupees in taxes. But this success is in rupees only. Our external balance sheet – the one measured in dollars – remains dangerously weak.

title: Media Law Forum strengthens Sri Lankan journalists against election disinformation
byline: Democracy does not sustain itself automatically. It depends on an informed public, and an informed public depends on journalists who understand not only how to report, but also the legal and ethical boundaries within which reporting must take place.

title: The fast-spreading Ebola outbreak in central Africa
byline: A rare strain of Ebola has prompted the World Health Organization to declare a public health emergency of international concern.

title: Exporters warn currency gains being wiped out by higher import bills
byline: Sri Lanka’s fast weakening rupee is beginning to expose a deeper strain within the country’s export sector, with exporters warning that the rising cost of imported fuel, raw materials and industrial inputs is rapidly eroding the short-term gains from a stronger dollar.

title: American who contracted Ebola in DR Congo evacuated for treatment
byline: An American tested positive for Ebola after being exposed while working with a medical missionary group in the Democratic Republic of Congo, US officials say.

title: Magnitude 5.9 earthquake hits off southwestern Japan
byline: A magnitude 5.9 earthquake shook southern Japan on Wednesday, according to the US Geological Survey. The quake occurred at 11:46 a.m. local time (0246GMT) at a depth of 50 kilometers (31 miles).

title: Uproar in Parliament after Chamara Sampath prevented from raising privilege issue
byline: Commotion reigned in Parliament today when Opposition Member of Parliament Chamara Sampath Dassanayake was prevented from raising a privilege issue.

title: Minimum bus fare could increase to Rs. 40 due to rupee depreciation: Gemunu
byline: The minimum bus fare could increase to Rs. 40 following the upcoming annual revision in July, as further weakening of the Sri Lankan Rupee against the US Dollar may push up transport costs, Lanka Private Bus Owners’ Association (LPBOA) Chairman Gemunu Wijeratne has warned.

title: Imported milk powder price increased from today
byline: The Milk Powder Importers’ Association has announced a revision in the prices of imported milk powder, citing prevailing market conditions and exchange rate fluctuations.

title: Sri Lanka, UN discuss wide-ranging reforms in digital governance drive
byline: A wide-ranging bilateral discussion was held between the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government, Professor Chandana Abayarathne, and UN Resident Coordinator in Sri Lanka Marc-André Franche, focusing on accelerating Sri Lanka’s digital governance, institutional reforms, and disaster management systems.

title: Childhood cancer care must focus on how survivors live, not just survival - Nalinda
byline: “The true measure of success in childhood cancer is not only how many children survive, but how they live,” Sri Lankan Health and Mass Media Minister Nalinda Jayatissa said while addressing a special session on childhood cancer care held on the sidelines of the 79th World Health Assembly in Geneva.

title: U.N. cuts global growth forecast to 2.5%, blames Middle East crisis
byline: The United Nations on Tuesday cut its forecast for global economic growth, saying the Middle East crisis had reignited inflationary pressures and heightened ​uncertainty.

title: Three Chinese nationals detained at BIA over Rs. 514,000 electronics smuggling attempt
byline: Airport customs officers at Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) arrested three Chinese nationals on the night of 19 May after they allegedly attempted to smuggle mobile phones and batteries valued at Rs. 514,000 into Sri Lanka using the “Green Channel” meant for non-declarable goods.

title: China confirms it will buy 200 Boeing jets after Trump-Xi summit
byline: China has confirmed that it will buy 200 Boeing jets after US President Donald Trump and his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping met in Beijing last week.

title: PM Harini delivers lecture at Oxford
byline: Prime Minister Harini Amarasuriya delivered the 2026 OSGA Annual Lecture at the University of Oxford, addressing global themes of development, governance, and political reform.

title: Man who murdered teen TikTok star in Pakistan gets death sentence
byline: A court in Pakistan has sentenced a man to death over the murder of a teen social media influencer that sparked uproar across the country.

title: Hatton trader fined Rs. 100,000 for violating rice MRP regulations
byline: A Hatton-based trader has been fined Rs. 100,000 by the Hatton Magistrate’s Court for selling Keeri Samba rice above the government-approved maximum retail price (MRP).

title: President opens Batticaloa library
byline: The new Public Library Building of the Batticaloa Municipal Council was officially vested in the public on Tuesday (20) in the presence of President Anura Kumara Dissanayake, with former Parliamentarian M.A. Sumanthiran ceremonially declaring the building open.

title: Milk tea price to increase by Rs. 5 tonight
byline: The price of a cup of milk tea will be increased by Rs. 5 with effect from midnight today (20), the All Ceylon Restaurant and Bar Owners Association said.

title: MP Chamara Sampath not allowed to attend Parliament sessions today: Serjeant-at-Arms
byline: MP Chamara Sampath will not be allowed to attend Parliament sessions today (May 20 2026), Serjeant-at-Arms Kushan Jayarane said.

title: Chamith Wijesundera calls for balanced remembrance, condemns LTTE atrocities
byline: SJB Youth Organizer Chamith Wijesundera has called for a balanced approach to remembrance of Sri Lanka’s war-related civilian deaths, warning against any attempt to glorify the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE).

title: US Senate advances measure curbing Trump’s Iran war powers
byline: The U.S. Senate advanced a war-powers resolution on Tuesday that would end ​the Iran war unless President Donald Trump obtains Congress’ authorization, a rare rebuke of the Republican leader 80 days after ‌U.S. and Israeli forces began striking Iran.

title: SL Rupee depreciates further against US Dollar
byline: The Sri Lankan Rupee continued its downward trend against the US Dollar today, with selling rate increased to Rs. 342, according to the Central Bank of Sri Lanka.

title: Market slides sharply as broad-based selling pressure weighs on investor sentiment
byline: The Colombo Stock Exchange witnessed a sharp decline during today’s trading session, as subdued investor confidence and prevailing market uncertainty triggered broad-based selling pressure from the opening bell. The market remained under pressure throughout the day, with cautious sentiment dominating trading activity amid the absence of strong buying interest.

title: Cotta Road level crossing closed for urgent renovation on Kelani Valley Line
byline: Train operations on the Kelani Valley Line will be temporarily revised, while the Cotta Road level crossing will be fully closed for vehicular traffic due to essential renovation work carried out by the Railway Department.

title: Health Ministry gears up for Ebola outbreak
byline: The Ministry of Health has decided to implement measures consisting of five steps in line with the recommendations of the World Health Organisation (WHO), following the WHO declaration of the Ebola virus epidemic situation as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

title: IPL Fireball for Sri Lanka Tour
byline: The entire cricketing world is talking about him and next month India’s 15-year old batting dynamite may bring some sections of life in Sri Lanka to a standstill when he tours the island with his country’s second string team that has many players currently drawing packed stadia at the Indian Premier League (IPL).

title: High blood pressure cases on the rise in Sri Lanka: Health experts warn
byline: Health authorities in Sri Lanka have warned of a rising number of high blood pressure cases across the country, urging the public to take greater care in monitoring and controlling both systolic and diastolic blood pressure levels.

title: Two companies loyal to NPP open 4,000 LCs day before surcharge imposed: Marikkar
byline: Two companies loyal to the National People’s Power (NPP) government have opened Letters of Credit (LCs) to import 4,000 vehicles on May 15, a day before the government imposed a 50 percent surcharge on vehicle imports, Samagi Jana Balawegaya MP S.M. Marikkar alleged today.

title: Meeting Pillayan in prison no secret: Namal
byline: Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP) MP Namal Rajapaksa said it is no secret that he visited TMVP leader Sivasathurai Chandrakanthan, also known as Pillayan, while he was in prison in 2018/19.

title: Mahinda, Basil, Namal met Pillayan in Batticaloa prison after Easter attacks, ASG tells court
byline: The court hearing into the investigations related to the 2019 Easter Sunday bomb attacks was marked by explosive allegations before the Colombo Fort Magistrate’s Court by the prosecution, including claims linking former political leaders, military intelligence officials and the alleged conspiracy surrounding the attacks.
